'''Sparkdoe''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Voltfawn]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Zapantler]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Assigned to sentry duty, Sparkdoe's magnetized antlers can sense distant disturbances. This hardworking Tatari's biggest hope is to finish work and clock out on time."

Sparkdoe is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
An orange, yellow, and white deer with under-eye bags and U-shaped magnets for antlers. Each antler is colored at the tips in blue (magnetic north poles) or red (magnetic south poles).

Sparkdoe's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with cyan. The colors of the magnetic poles on its antlers remain the same.

==Evolution Trial==
Sparkdoe's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Zapantler]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Sparkdoe to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Events#Treasure Hunt|Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Events#Cozy Farm|Cozy Farm]] (use x4200 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "The bags under its eyes show that it's lost its passion. Beating [[Zobos]] has worn down its antlers."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Sparkdoe has lost that spark from fighting Zobos day after day. Now it's just fire, fight, and clock out."

==Strategy==
[[File:Sparkdoe Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Sparkdoe's attack range]]
Sparkdoe's ability to paralyze Zobos gives your other Tatari a chance to deal critical damage.
